setup: A decimal is subtracted from a fraction.

steps.say: The fraction is [[a]]/[[b]], which is rewritten in hundredths first.
The decimal is the two-digit number [[dec]] after the point, so it counts [[dec]] hundredths.
Both values are then in hundredths, so the smaller numerator is taken from the larger over 100.

answer: So the value asked for is [[answer]].
